stamp._why: The one Welcome of Tombstack lives in the SDK (monorepo tombstack, unity/, mirrored to the public tombstack-unity), so GitHub users see it too; the Asset Store package installs the SDK and keeps only CLICKME, whose inspector draws this package's hub (clickme.py host). Its own asmdef AnkleBreaker.Tombstack.Editor.Welcome references nothing. Prefix TombstackSdk: the Asset Store package's earlier Welcome used Tombstack*, and identical file names would make the name-search fallbacks ambiguous until its cleanup runs. Prefs keep the Asset Store package's CanonicalWelcome prefix: whoever saw that Welcome is not shown this one again.
